text:
elyse: uploaded a quick perf trace from a failing canary run — nvprof + perf + a short perf flame for the CPU side. Seeing weird spikes in Python around the batching loop and tokenizer handoff. link: https://perflog.redwood/internal/2002/trace-2002003456

trent: grabbing it now. which model and batch profile?

elyse: gpt-small-ish replica, sequence=1024, steady 120rps, batcher target 8 but observed variance 1-12 on hot path. KV cache hits ~82%.

mike: quick skim of nvprof timeline in the trace: GPU kernels look fine, long idle gaps line up with Python GC-ish pauses. posting flame snippet in a sec.

zach: can you paste the perf record command you ran? helps reproduce.

elyse: ran `perf record -F 997 -g --call-graph dwarf -p <server_pid> -- sleep 60` on the worker that handled the canary. also did `python -m pyflame -o pyflame.svg <pid>` for a sample.

perf-bot: new artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-perf/2002/2002003456/perf.data (sha256: abcd...)
